caption:
Cross-multiply the whole numerator, not half.

Wrap each numerator in parentheses: 3(2x + 1) = 5(x − 4). Then x = −23.

Save this for test day.

youtube.title: Cross-Multiplying Without Mistakes: SAT Algebra
youtube.description: Use parentheses when you cross-multiply so every term gets multiplied. SAT-style practice question (original).
